rules.title: 80 columns
rules.text: Keep lines at 80 characters or fewer.

rules.title: 100 columns
rules.text: Keep lines at 100 characters or fewer.

rules.title: 120 columns
rules.text: Keep lines at 120 characters or fewer.

rules.title: Use the project formatter
rules.text: Format code with the project formatter instead of hand-formatting; do not mix formatting changes with logic changes.

rules.title: Final newline
rules.text: End every file with a single newline and strip trailing whitespace.

rules.title: Match existing style
rules.text: Match the style of the surrounding code when it conflicts with a general preference.
